description:
meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Turbo: OpenAI-style chat completion. Paid chat completion answered by Llama 3.1 8B through the estate rail on Base; returns the model's reply text for one prompt per call. Returns: an OpenAI-style chat completion from the model the service is named for: POST {messages: [{role, content}], max_tokens <= 1024}; returns the assistant message, the model, and its token usage. Messages up to 16,000 characters in total.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_q_verdict_v1/llama3_1_8b_chat. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
